Quote: RBI increased risk weights on consumer credit exposure from 100% to 125% which had an impact of 290 bps on the Company's CRAR. Adjusted for this change CRAR would have been 26.77%.
Given the increase in risk weights and higher incremental cost of funds, the Company has increased rates across all portfolios by 20-30 bps.

Company: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd.
Source: Q3 FY24 investor presentation (24-3), capital adequacy slide
